question.text: How many drones will Russia launch at Ukraine overnight on 26–27 November 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves on the number of drones that the Ukrainian Air Force reports as launched by Russian forces at Ukraine in its overnight summary for the night of 26–27 November 2026 — the summary first published on the morning of 27 November 2026 (Kyiv time), covering whatever overnight period that summary itself states. The resolving figure is the aggregate "launched" total given in that summary and published in English by [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/) or [Ukrinform's war feed](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato) — i.e., the number in reports headlined along the lines of "Russia launches N drones at Ukraine overnight". Example of scale: a report stating that Russia attacked with 310 drones, of which 272 were downed, resolves as 310 (entered as 310). If the summary reports that no drones were launched at Ukraine in that window, the question resolves as 0. If the Air Force's figure for this attack window is not published by either outlet, [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) reporting the Air Force's figures will be used.
question.fine_print: Drones of all types count: Shahed/Geran strike drones (including jet-powered variants) and decoy drones such as Gerbera and Parodiya. Missiles of any kind (cruise, ballistic or aeroballistic) are not counted. If the Air Force summary gives per-type drone counts but no aggregate total, the value is the sum of the reported drone counts. If the Air Force publishes both an overnight figure for the night of 26–27 November and a separate combined 24-hour figure, the overnight figure is used. If more than one figure for this overnight window is published, the latest figure published before 12:00 UTC on 27 November 2026 is used.

research:
I've pulled together recent nightly figures, last year's values for the same dates, and market prices. No figure exists yet for the target night, and none of the markets match the question directly.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the Ukrainian Air Force's morning summary as published in English by Ukrainska Pravda or Ukrinform. Ukrinform's war feed, checked at about 02:00 UTC on 2026-11-17, did not yet have a summary for the night of 16-17 November. The most recent one covers 15-16 November. [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato)
- Format to expect: drones are counted "from 18:00" the evening before, as a launched total, with downed or suppressed counts given "as of 07:30/08:00". Example: 158 launched, 131 neutralized, for 15-16 November. [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/amp/rubric-ato/4185017-ukraines-adf-down-131-of-158-russian-drones-launched-since-evening.html)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. The attack night is 26-27 November, and the outcome is open.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-16 to 17: Zelensky said Russia plans to increase missile production and receives ballistic missiles from North Korea every month. Drone debris fell in Kyiv's Desnianskyi district on 16 November. [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato)
- 2026-11-16: Russia's defence ministry claimed it intercepted 1,336 Ukrainian drones in one night, a record. Retaliation risk is worth weighing. [ThePrint](https://theprint.in/world/ukraine-launches-biggest-drone-attack-on-russia-since-war-began-defence-ministry-data-shows/3100085/)
- 2026-11-16: 158 drones launched (77 of them jet-powered Shaheds), 131 downed, hits at 19 locations. [Interfax](https://en.interfax.com.ua/news/general/1236913.html)
- 2026-11-15: 132 drones launched (78 jet-powered), 106 downed. [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062918/)
- 2026-11-14: 96 drones launched, 81 downed. [Interfax](https://en.interfax.com.ua/news/general/1236499-amp.html)
- 2026-11-13: 117 launched, 80 downed. [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184168-air-defense-downs-80-of-117-russian-drones-launched-overnight.html)

## 4. Base rates
- Nightly totals for November 2026 (Air Force figures via Ukrinform and others):
  - 31 Oct-1 Nov: 433 ([Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4180165-air-defense-neutralizes-371-of-433-russian-drones-launched-against-ukraine-overnight.html))
  - 1-2 Nov: 193
  - 2-3 Nov: 289
  - 3-4 Nov: 310 ([Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4181220-air-defense-neutralizes-272-of-310-drones-launched-by-russia-against-ukraine-overnight.html))
  - 4-5 Nov: 128 drones plus 2 Kh-35 missiles ([Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4181598-adf-neutralises-105-russian-drones-since-yesterday-evening.html))
  - 5-6 Nov: about 227. The night is my inference from article order. ([Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4181994-adf-neutralizes-196-russian-drones-used-to-attack-ukraine-overnight.html))
  - 7-8 Nov: 164
  - 8-9 Nov: 317
  - 9-10 Nov: 162
  - 10-11 Nov: 163
  - 12-13 Nov: 117
  - 13-14 Nov: 96
  - 14-15 Nov: 132
  - 15-16 Nov: 158
  - I could not find figures for 6-7 or 11-12 November.
- Trend:
  - Early November had several nights above 280.
  - Since 9 November every night has been 96 to 163, a lull while talks were running.
  - Across the 14 known nights, the median is about 164 and the range is 96 to 433.
  - Roughly 1 night in 3 to 4 exceeds 280.
  - Large combined strikes tend to come every 5 to 7 days, after quieter nights of 100 to 170.
- The same window in earlier years:
  - 2025:
    - 18-19 Nov: 476 drones plus 48 missiles ([UP](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/11/19/8007969))
    - 23-24 Nov: about 162 (125 downed) ([UP](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/11/24/8008693))
    - 24-25 Nov: about 464 plus 22 missiles ([UP](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/11/25/8008869))
    - **26-27 Nov 2025: 142** ([UP](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/11/27/8009175))
    - 27-28 Nov: 72 plus an Iskander ([UP](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/11/28/8009356))
    - 28-29 Nov: 596 drones plus 36 missiles ([online.ua](https://news.online.ua/en/russia-attacked-ukraine-with-36-missiles-and-596-drones-577-targets-neutralized-899254/))
  - **26-27 Nov 2024: 89 drones** ([RBC](https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/russia-launches-89-drones-on-ukraine-air-1732697149.html))
  - Late November in both years was a heavy-strike period ahead of winter. Year-on-year volume has grown: the background puts 2026's average at about 200 to 220 a day. The last week has run below that average.

## 5. Other forecasts
- No prediction market or Metaculus question on nightly drone counts was found.
- Related markets, as of 2026-11-17:
  - Polymarket gives 24% to a "next Russia-Ukraine senior diplomatic meeting" by 30 November and 71% by 31 December.
  - Polymarket gives 3% to an EU-Russia-Ukraine trilateral meeting by 30 November.
  - Kalshi gives 6% to a Trump-Zelensky-Putin meeting before 2027.
  - Reading: talks this month are possible but unlikely, and the markets give little sign of an energy truce before 27 November.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The next trilateral round with European participation has been agreed but has no date. Peskov said only "foreseeable future" (13 November, per the question background). A meeting or truce could lower drone numbers. Past rounds have sometimes come just before or after large strikes.
- Ukraine's record long-range drone strikes on Russia (1,336 claimed on 16 November) may prompt Russian "retaliation" barrages.
- The energy campaign continues, with more than 310 strikes on energy facilities since 1 November per Zelensky. Cold weather typically brings the large combined strikes, which have reached 400 to 600 drones. I did not find a weather forecast for 26-27 November.
- The 16-17 November figure should be published about 06:00 UTC today, after this research was done.

- November 2026 nightly totals so far: 193, 289, 310, 164, 317, 162, 163, 117, 96, 132, 158.

- The pattern is lulls of 100 to 170 drones, broken by occasional surges of 290 to 320 drones (three in the first nine days of November). No night in November 2026 has gone above 320. In April 2026 three nights went above 600, and the war's record is 810 (7 Sept 2025).
- Same night in earlier years:
  - **26-27 Nov 2025:** 142 drones. [UP](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/11/27/8009175)
  - **26-27 Nov 2024:** 89 drones in the initial report. One outlet gave 142, but that article appears to describe 2025, so treat the 2024 figure as 89. [UP](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2024/11/27/7486511), [NV](https://english.nv.ua/amp/russia-attacks-ukraine-with-89-drones-air-defense-shoots-down-36-50469697.html)

- Seasonality: in mid-to-late November 2025, nights were mostly 70 to 180 drones (for example 176 on 16 Nov, 162 on 24 Nov, 72 on 26 Nov, 142 on 27 Nov). I recall large combined strikes around 25 and 29 Nov 2025 (several hundred drones each), but I did not verify them. 2026 is running higher than 2024 and somewhat higher than 2025.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no market or expert forecast on nightly drone counts.
- Related markets on diplomacy, which could matter if talks bring a lull:
  - Polymarket gives about 24% to a senior Russia-Ukraine meeting by 30 Nov, and 71% by 31 Dec.
  - Polymarket gives about 3% to a Russia-Ukraine-EU trilateral meeting by 30 Nov.
  - Kalshi gives 6% to a Trump-Putin-Zelensky meeting before 2027.
  - None of these imply an energy truce before 27 Nov.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The Air Force's warning of a prepared large-scale strike makes a 300+ drone surge somewhat more likely in the next 10 days. That strike could come before 26 Nov or fall on the target night.
- Russia may retaliate for the 1,336-drone attack and the Crimean bridge strike.
- A Ramstein donor meeting is upcoming, with air defence as the priority (date not confirmed).
- A further trilateral round with Europeans is agreed but has no date.
- Weather: I found no official forecast. Late-November weather can affect launches, but the data show no clear effect.
